align.zh-CN: 对话布局方式，可选 leftRight（左右分布）或 leftAlign（左对齐）。

chats.zh-CN: 受控对话消息列表，配合 v-model:chats 使用。
chats.en-US: Controlled list of conversation messages; bind it with v-model:chats.

disabledFileItemClick.zh-CN: 是否禁用文件卡片的点击。
disabledFileItemClick.en-US: Whether clicking a file card is disabled.

escapeHtml.zh-CN: 是否转义用户消息中的 HTML 标签，避免被 Markdown 解析器当作 HTML 处理而丢失内容。
escapeHtml.en-US: Whether to escape HTML tags in user messages, so the Markdown parser does not treat them as HTML and drop content.

hintCls.en-US: Class name of the outermost hint area element.

hints.zh-CN: 提示信息。点击某条提示后，它成为新的用户消息，并触发 hintClick。
hints.en-US: Hint texts. Clicking a hint turns it into a new user message and emits hintClick.

hintStyle.en-US: Style of the outermost hint area element.

markdownRenderProps.zh-CN: 透传给每条消息所用 MarkdownRender 的属性，raw 由消息决定，不可传入；components 与内置组件合并，同名的（如 code）覆盖内置组件。
markdownRenderProps.en-US: Props passed to the MarkdownRender of each message. raw is decided by the message and cannot be passed; components are merged with the built-in ones, and a component with the same name (such as code) replaces the built-in one.

mode.zh-CN: 对话模式，可选 bubble、noBubble 或 userBubble。
mode.en-US: Conversation mode: bubble, noBubble or userBubble.

roleConfig.zh-CN: 各角色（user、assistant、system 等）的名称、头像与头像颜色，必填，不读取全局默认值。
roleConfig.en-US: Name, avatar and avatar color of each role (user, assistant, system and so on). Required, and not read from the global defaults.

showReset.en-US: Whether to show the reset action.

showReference.zh-CN: 是否在文字或文件消息中展示可被引用的图标，仅对用户消息生效。
showReference.en-US: Whether to show the reference icon on text or file messages. Only user messages are affected.

update:chats.zh-CN: 消息列表变化时触发，v-model:chats 据此更新，与 chatsChange 传出同一个数组。
update:chats.en-US: Emitted when the message list changes; v-model:chats updates from it. It carries the same array as chatsChange.

chatsChange.zh-CN: 消息列表变化时触发，载荷为新的消息数组。
chatsChange.en-US: Emitted when the message list changes, with the new message array.

annotationClick.zh-CN: 点击参考来源时触发，载荷为被点击消息块的注释数组。
annotationClick.en-US: Emitted when the references of a message block are clicked, with that block's annotations.

fileClick.en-US: Emitted when a file card is clicked.

hintClick.en-US: Emitted when a hint is clicked.

imageClick.en-US: Emitted when an image is clicked.

messageBadFeedback.en-US: Emitted when a message is disliked.

messageCopy.zh-CN: 复制消息时触发：文本写入剪贴板成功后才触发，复制的文本不含推理内容；没有可复制的文本时既不写入也不触发。
messageCopy.en-US: Emitted when a message is copied, after the text has been written to the clipboard successfully. The copied text excludes reasoning; a message without text is neither written nor reported.

messageDelete.en-US: Emitted when a message is deleted.

messageEdit.en-US: Emitted when a message is edited.

messageGoodFeedback.en-US: Emitted when a message is liked.

messageReset.en-US: Emitted when a message is reset.

messageShare.en-US: Emitted when a message is shared.

referenceClick.zh-CN: 点击引用按钮时触发。载荷没有 id，加入 AIChatInput 的 references 前由使用方补上；文件项没有 type。
referenceClick.en-US: Emitted when a reference button is clicked. The payload has no id, which the caller adds before putting it into the references of AIChatInput; a file item has no type.

select.zh-CN: 选中的消息变化时触发。
select.en-US: Emitted when the selected messages change.

avatar.zh-CN: 自定义头像，参数含默认头像 defaultAvatar、消息 message 与角色 role。
avatar.en-US: Custom avatar, with the default avatar defaultAvatar, the message and the role.

title.zh-CN: 自定义标题，参数含默认标题 defaultTitle、消息 message 与角色 role。
title.en-US: Custom title, with the default title defaultTitle, the message and the role.

content.zh-CN: 自定义内容区域，参数含默认内容 defaultContent、消息 message、角色 role 与 class。defaultContent 与默认渲染一致，包含引用列表与加载指示。
content.en-US: Custom content area, with the default content defaultContent, the message, the role and class. defaultContent matches the default rendering, including the reference list and the loading indicator.

action.zh-CN: 自定义消息操作栏，参数含默认按钮数组 defaultActions、按名称索引的 defaultActionsObj、消息 message 与 class；按钮不显示时（如消息未完成）对应的键不存在。
action.en-US: Custom action bar, with the default buttons defaultActions, the same buttons by name defaultActionsObj, the message and class. A key is missing when its button is not shown, for example while the message is unfinished.

fullDialogue.zh-CN: 完全自定义整条对话，参数含 defaultNodes（avatar、title、content、action）、消息 message、角色 role 与 class。
fullDialogue.en-US: Replaces a whole dialogue, with defaultNodes (avatar, title, content, action), the message, the role and class.

contentItem.zh-CN: 按内容项自定义渲染，每个内容项都会先经过它，参数含 item、type、message、index 与 parent；返回空内容时由内置渲染接管。
contentItem.en-US: Custom rendering by content item. Every item passes through it first, with item, type, message, index and parent; empty output leaves the item to the built-in rendering.

messageText.zh-CN: 替换内容为纯文本的消息的 Markdown 渲染，参数含文本 text 与消息 message。
messageText.en-US: Replaces the Markdown rendering of a message whose content is plain text, with the text and the message.

messageEdit.zh-CN: 用户消息处于编辑状态时显示的编辑器，参数为消息转换得到的输入内容。
messageEdit.en-US: The editor shown while a user message is being edited; its parameters are the input content converted from the message.

hintBox.zh-CN: 自定义提示项，参数含提示文本 content、序号 index 与点击回调 onHintClick。
hintBox.en-US: Custom hint item, with the hint text content, the index and the click callback onHintClick.

scrollToBottom.zh-CN: 滚动到最底部，参数为 true 时带动画。
scrollToBottom.en-US: Scrolls to the bottom, animated when the argument is true.

scrollToTop.zh-CN: 滚动到最顶部，参数为 true 时带动画。
scrollToTop.en-US: Scrolls to the top, animated when the argument is true.

status.zh-CN: 推理状态。为 completed 时标题显示已完成，且初次渲染时折叠；其他值显示思考中并展开。
status.en-US: Reasoning status. completed shows the finished title and starts collapsed; any other value shows the thinking title and starts expanded.

summary.zh-CN: 推理摘要，非空时按换行拼接其中的文本作为推理正文。
summary.en-US: Reasoning summary. When it is not empty, its texts joined by line breaks form the reasoning text.

content.zh-CN: 推理内容，summary 为空时按换行拼接其中的文本作为推理正文。
content.en-US: Reasoning content. When summary is empty, its texts joined by line breaks form the reasoning text.

markdownRenderProps.zh-CN: 透传给推理正文所用 MarkdownRender 的属性，raw 由推理正文决定。
markdownRenderProps.en-US: Props passed to the MarkdownRender of the reasoning text; raw comes from the reasoning text.

content.zh-CN: 替换推理正文的 Markdown 渲染，参数为 status、summary、content 与 markdownRenderProps。
content.en-US: Replaces the Markdown rendering of the reasoning text, with status, summary, content and markdownRenderProps.

steps.zh-CN: 步骤列表。每个步骤含 summary、status 与 actions，status 为 completed 时显示完成图标，否则显示加载中；actions 只放数据（summary、description 等），步骤可点击或用 Enter、空格展开收起。
steps.en-US: List of steps. Each step has summary, status and actions; completed shows the done icon, any other status shows loading. actions hold data only (summary, description and so on), and a step expands or collapses on click, Enter or Space.

actionIcon.zh-CN: 显示在每个操作描述前的图标，参数为操作 item、序号 index、所属步骤 step 与步骤序号 stepIndex。
actionIcon.en-US: Icon shown before each action's description, with the action item, its index, the step it belongs to and stepIndex.

maxCount.zh-CN: 最多显示的来源图标数，超出部分显示为 +N。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of source logos shown; the rest are shown as +N.

annotation.zh-CN: 参考来源列表，每项可含 title、logo、url、detail。
annotation.en-US: List of references; each item may have title, logo, url and detail.

description.zh-CN: 来源图标后的描述文字，不传时显示来源数量。
description.en-US: Text after the source logos; the number of references is shown when it is not set.

click.zh-CN: 点击或用 Enter、空格激活时触发，参数为原生事件与参考来源列表。
click.en-US: Emitted on click or on activation with Enter or Space, with the native event and the references.
